_comment: SHA-256 of the Ulanzi firmware files this port calls into. Only files with a recorded hash are trusted at runtime and by the updater; run `uv run tools/vendor_fingerprints.py capture CLOCK_IP` on a supported clock to fill in the rootfs libraries, then rebuild.

libulanzi-bootstrap.so.purpose: the vendor application; the launcher calls its Wi-Fi initialisation and falls back to it

libmi_ao.so.purpose: Sigmastar audio output; the port passes hand-measured structures to it and must not run against another build

libzknet.so.purpose: vendor network library; DHCP, static addressing and the fallback access point go through its C++ symbols
